options.content: **How to read:** the time picker sets *today's* window; every comparison panel shows the same window shifted back 24h. Redis keeps only **26h** of data, so keep the window **≤ 2h** (default: last 1h). Longer windows will show *Yesterday = 0* because that data has expired.
